name: cancel-digests
description: EIP-712 digests of the signed cancel messages (CancelOrder and CancelAll) under the same XO Market CLOB domain as orders. Encoding: orderId is a uint64 as a base-10 decimal string; marketId is a UTF-8 string, and the empty string means a global CancelAll; chainId is a JSON integer; exchange is a 0x-hex address (any case). expectedDigest is the full EIP-712 digest (0x1901 || domainSeparator || structHash), where structHash is keccak256(abi.encode(typeHash, orderId, keccak256(marketId))) for CancelOrder and keccak256(abi.encode(typeHash, keccak256(marketId))) for CancelAll. domain is the full EIP-712 domain the digest is computed under: it equals name "XO Market CLOB", version "1", inputs.chainId and the checksummed inputs.exchange, and no other domain field (no salt).
source: Computed by the SDK and checked against an independent EIP-712 encoding (the domain separator and the struct hashed by hand with keccak256 and ABI encoding, without a typed-data library). That encoding's domain separator equals the mainnet CTFExchange's domainSeparator(). Unlike order.json, the digests themselves are not read from a contract.
